title: Exhausted Clock Stops the Matcher
statement: For every $l\in\mathbb{N}$, every $pos,neg\in\text{Fin}(l)$, input word, row, target words, stream, cursor, clock length $N$, and flag word, if the matcher is in its initial search control with clock position $N$, one machine step puts it in the completed control. All tape contents and work-head positions remain as specified by that same search configuration.
replaced: For every search seam whose query clock is exhausted, one matcher step reads the clock blank and enters the completed live control without reading any stream bit; this includes the empty time-zero query.
